android.desc:
Knight's Tour turns the classic chess puzzle into a relaxing brain game: move the knight in an L shape and visit every square of the board exactly once.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap any square to place the knight and jump just like in chess. You can never land on the same square twice. Fill the whole board to win. Sounds easy... until you run out of moves!

FEATURES
• 500 levels sorted by difficulty: pixel art pictures, letters, numbers and shapes of every kind
• A gentle start with small boards that grows into giant figures
• Daily puzzle: a numbered board with a single solution. Start on 1 and land on each number on its move. The same for everyone, one attempt per day. Keep your streak alive!
• Streak shield and an archive with the puzzles of the last few days
• Classic mode: the original 8×8 board
• Handicap mode: random blocked squares in every game
• Undo, hints that show the next correct jump and smooth animations
• Share an animated replay of your tour
• Original music and sound effects
• Achievements and leaderboards with Google Play Games
• Progress saved in the cloud and synced across your devices
• Light and dark themes, portrait and landscape
• Available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese

Train your logic, think ahead and become a true master of the Knight's Tour!
